[SWS_DM_01046] Check supported DataIdentifier in active session
⌈
On
reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A) with transmission-
Mode different than ’stopSending’, a requested Periodic DataIdentifier shall be con-
sidered as supported if and only if the active session passes the execution per-
mission check according to [SWS_DM_00413] else process next periodic DID. If Session not supported for none of the periodic DIDs DM shall respond with NRC
0x31(requestOutOfRange).
⌋
